body.title: Add ReadOnlyCapability type and the stableDescriptorHash-keyed qualification cache
body.summary: Add the ReadOnlyCapability interface (status, allowedTools, reason?, provenAgainst: { stableDescriptorHash, effectiveConfigFingerprint } | undefined) to src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts, plus a module-level cache keyed by stableDescriptorHash. No behavior wiring yet -- this is the type/data-structure foundation the rest of the Story builds on.
acceptanceChecks: ReadOnlyCapability type matches sc3's amended interfaceSketch (stableDescriptorHash, effectiveConfigFingerprint) exactly, not the HLD's stale field names
The cache is a module-level Map (or equivalent) keyed by stableDescriptorHash, empty at module load

tests.name: stableDescriptorHash computation excluding outputDir and its hit/miss decision -- two calls differing only in outputDir still hit the cache
